title: Search filters the list by name, reference or text
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user.
  • The Notifications page is open on the Inbox tab.
  • 3 notifications addressed to you, from notes a second user wrote on work orders, using distinct references (different work orders) and message text.
  • More than 50 results, so a second page exists.
custom_steps:
1. Type part of a sender name in the Search box and watch the list.
  2. Search part of a reference (e.g. "4219") and part of the notification text, in different letter case.
  3. With a paged result set, run a search and check which page it starts on.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A search box filters the list as you type, matching any part of the sender's name, the reference shown, or the notification text.
  • Search matches on partial text and ignores letter case.
  • Searching starts again from the first page of results.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10244 (S1, Work the Notifications inbox); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S1; design boards InboxAfter/Main; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

  • S1-R7: “Search matches any part of the sender's name, the reference shown on the notification, or the notification text.”
